name: vinyl_canyon
theme: a spinning record under one amber lamp: the dive drops past the tonearm into a groove canyon whose walls are the engraved sound-wave itself, down to the pressed-vinyl grain, and the grain field folds straight back out into the whole disc's spiral of arcs — never leaves the turntable

registers.name: disc_face
registers.scene: a black record disc set on a dark platter, seen from straight above, hundreds of fine concentric arcs ringed across its face in petrol green and violet sheen, one warm amber lamp glint drawn across the rings, a plain dark label circle at the centre, a slim tonearm reaching in from the rim with a needle resting in the outer rings
registers.target: a band of fine concentric groove arcs, petrol sheen along them

registers.name: groove_field
registers.scene: a black record surface seen from straight above, dozens of fine parallel groove arcs sweeping across it in long shallow curves, oil-slick green and violet sheen rippling along their crests, warm amber light glinting off the ridge tops, faint dust specks caught between the arcs
registers.loop_target: a black record surface seen from straight above, dozens of fine parallel groove arcs in long shallow curves, oil-slick green and violet sheen along them
registers.target: a dark open groove, black and glass-smooth

registers.name: groove_canyon
registers.scene: a narrow canyon of polished black vinyl, its two walls cut into long trains of engraved wave ridges, crests and troughs stacked in rhythmic rows down both faces, a flat pebbled floor running between them into the distance, green and violet sheen sliding along the ridge edges, a warm amber gleam high on one rim
registers.target: a tall lacquered wave ridge, black with a bright edge

registers.name: ridge_crest
registers.scene: a long engraved wave ridge standing along the groove wall, rounded scallops repeating down its lacquered black crest, finer ripple trains cut across its flank, a pebbled slope spread below it, oil-slick violet and green banding washed over the lacquer, warm amber light running the length of the edge
registers.target: a rounded vinyl pebble, matte black and domed

registers.name: vinyl_grain
registers.scene: a broad field of pressed vinyl grain, thousands of soft rounded domes packed edge to edge, shallow dimples between them, faint concentric ripple lines running through the packing, an oil-slick film of green and violet washed over the domes, one warm amber sheen low across the field

music_theme: a petrol-dark turntable groove — soft vinyl crackle over a warm amber bass pulse, one bright shimmer landing on the grain-to-disc fold
